--// RAINBOW HUB v3.5 — Fly + ESP + Aimbot + Teleport (ALL FIXED) //--
--// by dyfufyfutyr 👑 //--

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

--// Налаштування //--
local SPEED = 60
local SMOOTHNESS = 0.15
local JOYSTICK_RADIUS = 60
local FLY_MAX = 1000
local WALK_MAX = 1000
local AUTOR_NAME = "dyfufyfutyr"
local LOAD_DURATION = 5

--// ---------- РОЛІ ---------- //
local CREATOR_NAMES = {
    ["dyfufyfutyr"] = true,
}

local function getRole(plr)
    if CREATOR_NAMES[plr.Name] then
        return "CREATOR", "👑", Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0)
    end
    return "USER", "🎮", Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 220)
end

--// Стан //--

local teamCheckEnabled = false
local ESP_MAX_DIST = 1000
local espConnections = {}
local velocity = Vector3.zero
local bodyVelocity, bodyGyro

--// Стан v3.5 //

local aimbotEnabled = false
local aimbotMode = "Hold"
local aimbotFOV = 100
local aimbotSmoothness = 0.25
local aimbotTargetPart = "Head"
local aimbotKeybind = Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2
local aimbotLockedTarget = nil
local showFOV = true
local espColorMode = "Rainbow"
local saveFileName = "rainbowhub_settings.json"

--// Джойстик //--
local joyActive = false
local joyInput = Vector2.zero
local joyTouch = nil

--// ---------- LOADING SCREEN ---------- //

local progressGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
progressGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.00, Color3.fromRGB(120, 100, 255)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.50, Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 200)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.00, Color3.fromRGB(100, 200, 255)),
})
progressGradient.Parent = progressFill

local loadStartTime = tick()

task.spawn(function()
    local hueShift = 0
    while tick() - loadStartTime < LOAD_DURATION do
        task.wait(0.05)
        hueShift = (hueShift + 0.008) % 1
        if myRole == "CREATOR" then
            local shimmer = 0.6 + math.sin(hueShift * math.pi * 8) * 0.4
            loadingText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215 * shimmer + 40, 0)
        else
            loadingText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(hueShift, 0.35, 1)
        end
    end
end)

task.spawn(function()
    while tick() - loadStartTime < LOAD_DURATION do
        task.wait(0.4)
        local elapsed = tick() - loadStartTime
        if elapsed > LOAD_DURATION then break end
        local dotCount = math.floor(elapsed / 0.4) % 4
        dotsText.Text = string.rep(".", dotCount)
    end
end)

task.spawn(function()
    while tick() - loadStartTime < LOAD_DURATION do
        task.wait(0.03)
        glowGradient.Rotation = (glowGradient.Rotation + 2) % 360
        glowCircle.BackgroundTransparency = 0.65 + math.sin(tick() * 3) * 0.08
    end
end)

task.spawn(function()
    while tick() - loadStartTime < LOAD_DURATION do
        task.wait(0.03)
        local elapsed = tick() - loadStartTime
        local progress = math.clamp(elapsed / LOAD_DURATION, 0, 1)
        progressFill.Size = UDim2.new(progress, 0, 1, 0)
    end
end)

task.spawn(function()
    task.wait(LOAD_DURATION)
    local fadeTime = 0.6
    local fadeStart = tick()
    while tick() - fadeStart < fadeTime do
        task.wait(0.03)
        local alpha = (tick() - fadeStart) / fadeTime
        loadingBg.BackgroundTransparency = alpha * 0.9
        glowCircle.BackgroundTransparency = alpha + 0.7 * (1 - alpha)
        loadingText.TextTransparency = alpha
        dotsText.TextTransparency = alpha
        loadingAuthor.TextTransparency = alpha
        progressBg.BackgroundTransparency = alpha
        progressFill.BackgroundTransparency = alpha
    end
    loadingGui:Destroy()
end)

--// ---------- GUI ---------- //
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")

print("[Rainbow Hub] ✅ GUI створено:", screenGui.Name)
print("[Rainbow Hub] 👤 Роль:", myRole)

local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")

scrollFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
scrollFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
scrollFrame.ScrollBarThickness = 4

scrollFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
scrollFrame.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
scrollFrame.Parent = mainFrame

local listLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
listLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
listLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
listLayout.Parent = scrollFrame

local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 4)
pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 4)
pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 4)
pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 8)
pad.Parent = scrollFrame

--// Звук //
local toggleSound = Instance.new("Sound")
toggleSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://6895079853"
toggleSound.Volume = 0.4
toggleSound.Parent = screenGui

local function playClick()
    if not soundEnabled then return end
    local s = toggleSound:Clone()
    s.Parent = screenGui
    s:Play()
    Debris:AddItem(s, 1)
end

--// ХЕЛПЕРИ ---------- //
local orderCounter = 0

local function makeToggleBtn(text, callback)
    orderCounter += 1
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 36)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 65)
    btn.Text = text
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    btn.TextSize = 14
    btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    btn.LayoutOrder = orderCounter
    btn.Parent = scrollFrame
    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

    local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    s.Thickness = 2
    s.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
    s.Parent = btn

    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        playClick()
        local ok, err = pcall(function()
            callback(btn, s)
        end)
        if not ok then
            warn("[Rainbow Hub Error]: " .. tostring(err))
        end
    end)
    return btn, s
end

local function updateBtnVisual(btn, stroke, isOn)
    if isOn then
        btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 150)
        stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 255, 120)
    else
        btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
        stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
    end
end

local function makeLabel(text, color)
    orderCounter += 1
    local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 18)
    lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    lbl.Text = text
    lbl.TextColor3 = color
    lbl.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    lbl.TextSize = 13
    lbl.LayoutOrder = orderCounter
    lbl.Parent = scrollFrame

end

local function makePairBtn(labelText, labelColor, onMinus, onPlus)
    local lbl = makeLabel(labelText, labelColor)

    orderCounter += 1
    local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
    holder.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 30)
    holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    holder.LayoutOrder = orderCounter
    holder.Parent = scrollFrame

    local minusBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    minusBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.48, 0, 1, 0)
    minusBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    minusBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 85)
    minusBtn.Text = "−"
    minusBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    minusBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    minusBtn.TextSize = 18
    minusBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    minusBtn.Parent = holder
    Instance.new("UICorner", minusBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

    local plusBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    plusBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.48, 0, 1, 0)
    plusBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.52, 0, 0, 0)
    plusBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 85)
    plusBtn.Text = "+"
    plusBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    plusBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    plusBtn.TextSize = 18
    plusBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    plusBtn.Parent = holder
    Instance.new("UICorner", plusBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

    minusBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        playClick()
        pcall(function() onMinus(lbl) end)
    end)
    plusBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        playClick()
        pcall(function() onPlus(lbl) end)
    end)
    return lbl
end

--// ---------- SAVE/LOAD ---------- //
local function saveSettings()
    local data = {
        SPEED = SPEED,
        walkSpeed = walkSpeed,
        ESP_MAX_DIST = ESP_MAX_DIST,
        aimbotFOV = aimbotFOV,
        aimbotSmoothness = aimbotSmoothness,
        espColorMode = espColorMode,
        soundEnabled = soundEnabled,
    }
    local ok, err = pcall(function()
        if writefile then
            writefile(saveFileName, HttpService:JSONEncode(data))
        end
    end)
    if ok then
        print("[Rainbow Hub] Налаштування збережено ✅")
    else
        warn("[Rainbow Hub] Не вдалось зберегти: " .. tostring(err))
    end
end

local function loadSettings()
    pcall(function()
        if readfile and isfile and isfile(saveFileName) then
            local content = readfile(saveFileName)
            local data = HttpService:JSONDecode(content)
            SPEED = data.SPEED or SPEED
            walkSpeed = data.walkSpeed or walkSpeed
            ESP_MAX_DIST = data.ESP_MAX_DIST or ESP_MAX_DIST
            aimbotFOV = data.aimbotFOV or aimbotFOV
            aimbotSmoothness = data.aimbotSmoothness or aimbotSmoothness
            espColorMode = data.espColorMode or espColorMode
            if data.soundEnabled ~= nil then soundEnabled = data.soundEnabled end
            print("[Rainbow Hub] Налаштування завантажено ✅")
        end
    end)
end

loadSettings()

--// ---------- ФУНКЦІЇ ПОЛЬОТУ ---------- //
local function createBodyMovers()
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return end

    if bodyVelocity then bodyVelocity:Destroy() end
    if bodyGyro then bodyGyro:Destroy() end

    bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e5, 1e5, 1e5)
    bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero
    bodyVelocity.Parent = hrp

    bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e5, 1e5, 1e5)
    bodyGyro.P = 1000
    bodyGyro.D = 50
    bodyGyro.CFrame = hrp.CFrame
    bodyGyro.Parent = hrp
end

local function destroyBodyMovers()
    if bodyVelocity then bodyVelocity:Destroy() bodyVelocity = nil end
    if bodyGyro then bodyGyro:Destroy() bodyGyro = nil end
end

--// ---------- ФУНКЦІЇ ESP ---------- //
local function isEnemy(plr)
    if not teamCheckEnabled then return true end
    if not plr.Team then return true end
    if not player.Team then return true end
    return plr.Team ~= player.Team
end

local function teleportToPlayer(target)
    if not target or target == player then return end
    if not target.Parent then return end

    local myChar = player.Character
    if not myChar then return end
    local myHrp = myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myHrp then return end

    local targetChar = target.Character
    if not targetChar then return end
    local targetHrp = targetChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not targetHrp then return end

    myHrp.CFrame = targetHrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3)
    myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero

    if flying then
        velocity = Vector3.zero
        if bodyVelocity then bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero end
    end

    print("[TP] ✅ Успішно телепортовано до " .. target.Name)
end

local function createESP(target)
    if target == player then return end
    if espConnections[target] then return end
    if not isEnemy(target) then return end

    local char = target.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hrp then return end

    print("[ESP] ➕ Створюю ESP для", target.Name)

    --// Highlight //
    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
    highlight.Name = "RainbowESP_" .. target.Name
    highlight.Adornee = char
    highlight.FillTransparency = 0.6
    highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
    highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
    highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
    highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
    highlight.Parent = char

    --// Billboard з іменем + HP + відстанню //
    local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    billboard.Name = "ESPTag_" .. target.Name
    billboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 70)
    billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
    billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
    billboard.Adornee = hrp
    billboard.Parent = char

    local nameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    nameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
    nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    nameLabel.Text = target.Name
    nameLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    nameLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
    nameLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    nameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    nameLabel.TextSize = 14
    nameLabel.Parent = billboard

    local hpBg = Instance.new("Frame")
    hpBg.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 8)
    hpBg.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0, 22)
    hpBg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
    hpBg.BorderSizePixel = 0
    hpBg.Parent = billboard
    Instance.new("UICorner", hpBg).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)

    local hpFill = Instance.new("Frame")
    hpFill.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    hpFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 100)
    hpFill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    hpFill.Parent = hpBg
    Instance.new("UICorner", hpFill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)

    local distLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    distLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16)
    distLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 34)
    distLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    distLabel.Text = ""
    distLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 255)
    distLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
    distLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    distLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    distLabel.TextSize = 12
    distLabel.Parent = billboard

    --// TP кнопка — окремо в ScreenGui щоб реагувала на кліки //
    local tpBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    tpBtn.Name = "TPBtn_" .. target.Name
    tpBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 28)
    tpBtn.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
    tpBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 200)
    tpBtn.Text = "🚀 TP → " .. string.sub(target.Name, 1, 8)
    tpBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    tpBtn.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
    tpBtn.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    tpBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    tpBtn.TextSize = 13
    tpBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    tpBtn.Active = true
    tpBtn.AutoButtonColor = true
    tpBtn.ZIndex = 100
    tpBtn.Visible = false
    tpBtn.Parent = screenGui
    Instance.new("UICorner", tpBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

    local tpStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    tpStroke.Thickness = 2
    tpStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 150)
    tpStroke.Parent = tpBtn

    tpBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        tpBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 230)
    end)
    tpBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        tpBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 200)
    end)
    tpBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
        tpBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 150)
    end)
    tpBtn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
        tpBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 230)
    end)

    tpBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        playClick()
        print("[TP] 🚀 Клік → телепорт до " .. target.Name)
        if not target or not target.Parent then
            warn("[TP] ❌ Гравець вийшов")
            return
        end
        teleportToPlayer(target)
    end)

    --// Tracer //
    local tracer = Instance.new("Frame")
    tracer.Name = "Tracer_" .. target.Name
    tracer.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
    tracer.BorderSizePixel = 0
    tracer.ZIndex = 5
    tracer.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    tracer.Visible = false
    tracer.Parent = screenGui

    --// ★ ОНОВЛЕННЯ КОЖЕН КАДР — ЗАХИЩЕНО pcall ★ //
    local conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        local ok, err = pcall(function()
            if not espEnabled then
                if tpBtn and tpBtn.Parent then tpBtn.Visible = false end
                if tracer and tracer.Parent then tracer.Visible = false end
                return
            end
            if not char or not char.Parent then return end
            if not hrp or not hrp.Parent then return end
            if not camera then return end

            local myHrp = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not myHrp then return end

            local dist = math.floor((myHrp.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude)
            local inRange = dist <= ESP_MAX_DIST

            --// Billboard + Highlight //
            if billboard and billboard.Parent then
                if billboard.Enabled ~= inRange then billboard.Enabled = inRange end
            end
            if highlight and highlight.Parent then
                if highlight.Enabled ~= inRange then highlight.Enabled = inRange end
            end

            if not inRange then
                if tpBtn and tpBtn.Parent and tpBtn.Visible then tpBtn.Visible = false end
                if tracer and tracer.Parent and tracer.Visible then tracer.Visible = false end
                return
            end

            --// Позиція TP кнопки //
            local headPos = hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
            local screenPos, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(headPos)

            if onScreen then
                if tpBtn and tpBtn.Parent then
                    tpBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, screenPos.X, 0, screenPos.Y + 55)
                    if not tpBtn.Visible then tpBtn.Visible = true end
                end
            else
                if tpBtn and tpBtn.Parent and tpBtn.Visible then tpBtn.Visible = false end
            end

            --// Distance //
            if distLabel and distLabel.Parent then
                distLabel.Text = dist .. " studs"
            end

            --// HP Bar //
            if humanoid and hpBg and hpFill then
                hpBg.Visible = true
                local hp = humanoid.Health / math.max(humanoid.MaxHealth, 1)
                hpFill.Size = UDim2.new(math.clamp(hp, 0, 1), 0, 1, 0)
                hpFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255 * (1 - hp), 255 * hp, 0)
            end

            --// Tracer //
            if tracerEnabled and onScreen then
                local screenSize = camera.ViewportSize
                local startPos = Vector2.new(screenSize.X / 2, screenSize.Y)
                local endPos = Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y)
                local delta = endPos - startPos
                local distance = delta.Magnitude
                local angle = math.atan2(delta.Y, delta.X)

                if tracer and tracer.Parent then
                    if not tracer.Visible then tracer.Visible = true end
                    tracer.Size = UDim2.new(0, distance, 0, 1.5)
                    tracer.Position = UDim2.new(0, (startPos.X + endPos.X) / 2, 0, (startPos.Y + endPos.Y) / 2)
                    tracer.Rotation = math.deg(angle)
                end
            else
                if tracer and tracer.Parent and tracer.Visible then tracer.Visible = false end
            end
        end)
        if not ok then
            warn("[ESP Loop Error]: " .. tostring(err))
        end
    end)

    espConnections[target] = {
        highlight = highlight,
        billboard = billboard,
        tracer = tracer,
        tpBtn = tpBtn,
        conn = conn,
    }
end

local function removeESP(target)
    local data = espConnections[target]
    if not data then return end
    print("[ESP] ➖ Видаляю ESP для", target.Name)
    if data.highlight then data.highlight:Destroy() end
    if data.billboard then data.billboard:Destroy() end
    if data.tracer then data.tracer:Destroy() end
    if data.tpBtn then data.tpBtn:Destroy() end
    if data.conn then data.conn:Disconnect() end
    espConnections[target] = nil
end

    for target, _ in pairs(espConnections) do

end

local function getClosestTargetToCursor()
    local mousePos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    local closest = nil
    local closestDist = aimbotFOV

    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= player and isEnemy(plr) then
            local char = plr.Character
            if char then
                local part = char:FindFirstChild(aimbotTargetPart) or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if part and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                    local screenPos, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
                    if onScreen then
                        local screenPoint = Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y)
                        local delta = screenPoint - mousePos
                        local dist = delta.Magnitude
                        if dist < closestDist then
                            closestDist = dist
                            closest = part
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return closest
end

            if aimbotLockedTarget then
                local targetPos = aimbotLockedTarget.Position
                local currentCFrame = camera.CFrame

                if aimbotSmoothness >= 0.9 then

                else
                    camera.CFrame = currentCFrame:Lerp(newCFrame, aimbotSmoothness)
                end
            end

            aimbotLockedTarget = nil
        end
    end
end)

local function updateJoystick(inputPos)
    local center = joystickGui.AbsolutePosition + joystickGui.AbsoluteSize / 2
    local delta = inputPos - center
    local maxDist = joystickGui.AbsoluteSize.X / 2
    if delta.Magnitude > maxDist then
        delta = delta.Unit * maxDist
    end
    joyKnob.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, delta.X - JOYSTICK_RADIUS/2, 0.5, delta.Y - JOYSTICK_RADIUS/2)
    joyInput = Vector2.new(delta.X / maxDist, delta.Y / maxDist)
end

function resetJoystick()
    joyInput = Vector2.zero
    joyActive = false
    joyTouch = nil
    if joyKnob and joyKnob.Parent then
        joyKnob.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -JOYSTICK_RADIUS/2, 0.5, -JOYSTICK_RADIUS/2)
    end
end

joystickGui.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        joyActive = true
        joyTouch = input
        updateJoystick(Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y))
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if not joyActive then return end
    if input == joyTouch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        if joyTouch and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input ~= joyTouch then return end
        updateJoystick(Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y))
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input == joyTouch then
        resetJoystick()
    end
end)

--// ---------- RESPAWN ---------- //
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
    task.wait(0.5)
    local humanoid = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
    if humanoid then
        humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping, true)
        humanoid.WalkSpeed = walkSpeed
    end

    local hrp = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
    if hrp then hrp.Anchored = false end

    if anchored then
        anchored = false
        anchorBtn.Text = "🧊 ANCHOR: OFF"
        updateBtnVisual(anchorBtn, anchorStroke, false)
    end

    task.wait(0.5)
    if flying then createBodyMovers() end
    task.wait(0.5)
    createMyTag()
end)

if player.Character then
    task.spawn(createMyTag)
end

--// ---------- РАЙДУЖНА АНІМАЦІЯ ---------- //
task.spawn(function()
    local hue = 0
    while screenGui.Parent do
        task.wait(0.03)
        hue = (hue + 0.01) % 1
        strokeGradient.Rotation = (strokeGradient.Rotation + 3) % 360
        joyGradient.Rotation = (joyGradient.Rotation + 4) % 360
        knobGradient.Rotation = (knobGradient.Rotation + 6) % 360
        reopenGradient.Rotation = (reopenGradient.Rotation + 5) % 360

        if myRole == "CREATOR" then
            local shimmer = 0.6 + math.sin(hue * math.pi * 8) * 0.4
            title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215 * shimmer + 40, 0)
        else
            title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 0.8, 1)
        end
    end
end)

task.spawn(function()
    local espHue = 0
    while screenGui.Parent do
        task.wait(0.05)
        if espEnabled then
            local color
            if espColorMode == "Rainbow" then
                espHue = (espHue + 0.01) % 1
                color = Color3.fromHSV(espHue, 1, 1)
            elseif espColorMode == "Red" then
                color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
            elseif espColorMode == "Green" then
                color = Color3.fromRGB(50, 255, 50)
            elseif espColorMode == "Blue" then
                color = Color3.fromRGB(50, 150, 255)
            elseif espColorMode == "Pink" then
                color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 200)
            else
                color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
            end
            for _, data in pairs(espConnections) do
                if data.highlight and data.highlight.Parent then
                    data.highlight.FillColor = color
                    data.highlight.OutlineColor = color
                end
                if data.tracer and data.tracer.Parent then
                    data.tracer.BackgroundColor3 = color
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

--// ---------- ОСНОВНИЙ ЦИКЛ FLY ---------- //
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not flying then return end

    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp or not bodyVelocity or not bodyGyro then return end

    local moveDir = Vector3.zero

    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then moveDir += camera.CFrame.LookVector end
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then moveDir -= camera.CFrame.LookVector end
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then moveDir -= camera.CFrame.RightVector end
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then moveDir += camera.CFrame.RightVector end
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then moveDir += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then moveDir -= Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end

    if joyActive and joyInput.Magnitude > 0.05 then
        moveDir += camera.CFrame.LookVector * (-joyInput.Y)
        moveDir += camera.CFrame.RightVector * joyInput.X
    end

    if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
        moveDir = moveDir.Unit
    end

    local targetVelocity = moveDir * SPEED
    velocity = velocity:Lerp(targetVelocity, SMOOTHNESS)
    bodyVelocity.Velocity = velocity
    bodyGyro.CFrame = CFrame.new(hrp.Position, hrp.Position + camera.CFrame.LookVector)
end)
